body.name: \mathcal E_{\lambda,\rho}
body.construction: Observe \(N\sim\operatorname{Poisson}(\lambda)\) and, conditional on \(N\), independent marks \(S_1,\ldots,S_N\) satisfying \(\Pr_\rho(S_\ell=1)=(1+c\rho)/2\) for \(\rho\in[-r,r]\); equivalently observe independent counts \((N_+,N_-)\) with mass \(f_{\lambda,\rho}(N_+,N_-)\).
